crossRefs.note: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

parallels.note: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

people.name: Athaliah
people.line: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: He was with her hidden in Yahweh’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
translations.bsb: And Joash remained hidden with his nurse in the house of the LORD for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
translations.kjv: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.
translations.asv: And he was with her hid in the house of Jehovah six years. And Athaliah reigned over the land.
